note: Private campground on the Powell River near Cumberland Gap, 575 Benfield Lane, Harrogate; its riverside sites are leased by the year or rented by the day. Strict park rules: no alcohol, no ATVs, no outside decorations, no generators except in a power outage. --Claude
summary: Mountain Pass Campground: operator page live (full-hookup river sites 'for yearly lease or daily rental'), no rate, count or engine anywhere official; Google 3.8 (73) - DROP CANDIDATE (under 4.0 with 25+ reviews; long-stay character with no posted nightly rate). Riverfront looks like riverview (pads ~4 m above the river behind bank trees). Pin ~290 m north of the loop.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviews): Google Maps 3.8 stars from 73 reviews - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. RV Life stored 4 stars / $$ (13 reviews per curation_note); RV Life's page content is script-rendered and was not read.

DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 2): the operator leads with 'available for yearly lease or daily rental' and its rules read as a residents' park ('If occupied from November through April, the water supply line must be of the heated type'; 'Building code in effect, please inquire'; gate code; rules for rugs, security cameras, plants and decorations). No nightly rate is posted on the operator site, there is no booking engine, and the nightly share could not be measured. A web-search snippet attributes $28-50 camper-reported nights (2020-2024) to RV Life; that page's reviews were not readable, so unverified. Mostly-seasonal + iffy + Google under 4 = drop per the reviewer rules.

WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview recommended (not changed): the west-row pads sit ~28 m from the Powell River, but 3DEP puts them ~4.2 m above the water (329.6 m vs 325.4 m at 36.5431,-83.5799 -> -83.5803) and a band of bank trees ~15-25 m deep lines the bank between pads and water on leaf-off Esri imagery (continuous canopy in summer). Over the 1-2 m kayak test and behind a tree line; no site numbers are published. The river is ~33 m wide here (riverfront-width, not creekside). Replacement evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-25: one road of angled gravel pads along the east bank of the Powell River (~33 m wide), 36.5445-36.5422; west-row pads ~28 m from the water behind a band of bank trees, 3DEP pads 329.6 m vs river 325.4 m (~4 m up) -> riverview'.

PIN: stored 36.54590,-83.58020 is the gravel turnaround at the north end of the entry road; the pads run 36.5445-36.5422 -> suggest 36.5433,-83.5799 (~290 m south). Google's place point 36.545028,-83.5801 is also at the north end.
